title: Gameplay Runtime Authority, Contract Registry & MAL/MRCS Convergence
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-20 owner approval replacing terminal MSAS persistent execution slot for concurrent GPR/MRCS implementation

selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-16 remains independent; OARC remains independent.

objective: Establish the reusable GPR execution/registry authority seam over frozen MAL and accepted MRCS definitions: stable runtime IDs, namespace/schema validation, unsupported-state fail-closed behavior and owner-preserving runtime bindings without creating a parallel rules/content or canonical-domain ledger.
boundaries: MAL-01..10 remain completed_verified and frozen; GPR reuses MAL primitives rather than reopening them.
MRCS retains reusable rule/content-definition authority; GPR imports/binds accepted definitions and may late-bind later MRCS domains.
Action/Event, Character, World/Scene, Combat, Inventory/Asset and other canonical owners retain mutation truth.
GPR-01 establishes runtime registry/import/authority seams only; it does not implement later GPR pattern modules, delivery modes or golden proof.
Unsupported definitions/operations remain unsupported; unknown owner data remains unknown.
MRCS and OARC lane state remains independent.
GPR-16 may not close before MRCS-21 and relevant specialist golden proofs.
next_action: On a GPR-specific owner Continue, fresh-read GPR-01, the GPR family design closure, ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json and ops3-lane-state/gpr, then execute the complete bounded tranche under OPS3 milestone-only execution.
